scenes.title: Lund MAX IV NanoMAX Imaging Endstation
scenes.institution: Lund University — MAX IV Laboratory — NanoMAX Imaging Endstation EH1
scenes.reference_notes: A real installed hutch photo shows a square multiport steel chamber at left connected to a long horizontal cylindrical flight tube running diagonally to a rear flange. Granite support blocks and an aluminium rail base support the entire assembly. A cantilevered actuator/slide projects into the right aisle; the rear wall/door is red, with high cable trays and a silver extraction duct. Lund University hosts MAX IV; retain that institutional attribution. EH1 and EH2 are endstations of the same NanoMAX laboratory and must not be counted separately. No X-rays, radiation, vacuum, fluorescence, ptychography, nanometre precision or microscope imaging is simulated.
